summary: On May 6, 2026, Chanson International Holding filed a Form 6-K announcing a 100-for-1 share consolidation effective May 7, 2026. The consolidation reduces outstanding Class A shares from ~363.9M to ~3.6M and adjusts par value from $0.0001 to $0.01. No fractional shares will be issued; shareholders receive one whole share in lieu. The ticker CHSN remains unchanged. This is a capital structure event typical for Nasdaq compliance, not a special situation like a tender offer or going-private transaction.
